## About this tool

pqscan is a command-line scanner. It reads one target or a target list. It
writes one scan record per target. The record shows the target's TLS and QUIC
configuration. The record also shows the target's post-quantum readiness
rating. The tool composes with the import toolset: target lines in, streaming
JSONL out. The `2026.01` release is live and attested. The
written specification is in force.

## What the record shows

Each record carries five parts.

- one negotiated key-group, for example X25519MLKEM768
- one cipher suite and one protocol version
- one certificate result: the signature and the key type
- one QUIC result, if the target answers the UDP plane
- one readiness rating: a number from 0 to 100

The machine formats give the record as JSON, CSV or text. The `-explain`
option adds the same facts as plain sentences. The text never adds facts the
record does not carry.

## What the tool reads

The tool reads simple target forms: a domain, an IP address, a host with a
port. It also reads scan results from other tools. Use these commands only.

- `subfinder -d shain.io -silent`
- `httpx -silent -ports 443,8443 -p 443,8443 -no-color`
- `naabu -l domains.txt -p 443,8443,465,993 -silent`
- `nuclei -l hosts.txt -silent -j`

These commands are fixed. Other output forms do not parse. The tool reports
the error and stops.

## Three scan modes

- *fast*: one handshake. The tool gives the record in milliseconds.
- *deep*: the probe matrix. The tool sends one probe at a time and records
  each answer.
- *pq*: the PQ offer set. The tool sends PQ-only offers. Each refusal carries
  the server's reason.

## Start

The [release page](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/releases) carries
attested static binaries for linux (amd64/arm64) and darwin/arm64. The three
lines below install the tool. The full matrix — source installs, checksum and
SLSA verification steps, Windows — lives in
[`INSTALL.md`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/INSTALL.md).

```bash
brew tap shsingh/tap && brew install pqscan        # macOS
go install github.com/shsingh/pqscan/cmd/pqscan@2026.01   # any platform with Go
gh attestation verify pqscan-<os>-<arch> -R shsingh/pqscan     # verify before running
```

Install the tool, then run the scan. Read the record and the plain sentences
under it.

```
pqscan -u example.com -explain
```

The sentences show what is safe today and what is not.

## Alternative tools

| Tool | Capability in common with pqscan | Divergence from pqscan's scope |
|---|---|---|
| [cryptonice](https://github.com/F5-Labs/cryptonice) | Multi-surface scan menu (TLS, HTTP, DNS, fingerprint) with structured JSON reporting | Python execution model without the throughput contract; PQC group and signature assessment out of scope |
| [gnutls-cli-debug](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man1/gnutls-cli-debug.1.html) | Exhaustive offer-and-observe protocol and suite probing | Interactive single-target scope; group and signature matrices are not scriptable |
| [testssl.sh](https://github.com/testssl/testssl.sh) | Wide protocol coverage including legacy versions, single-file portability | Serial execution model bounds estate-scale runs; PQC codepoints not classified |
| [sslyze](https://github.com/nabla-c0d3/sslyze) | Structured TLS probing library; base for several Python scanners | Per-target serial execution; no pipe-first interface |
| [zgrab2](https://github.com/zmap/zgrab2) | Modular scanner architecture designed for handshake rates at scale | One or few handshakes per host by design; no suite/group enumeration depth |
| [masscan / zmap](https://github.com/robertdavidgraham/masscan) | Rate-disciplined mass port discovery | Port discovery only, by design; composes with pqscan as input |
| [TLS-Scanner](https://github.com/tls-attacker/TLS-Scanner) | Exhaustive protocol analysis | Academic toolchain packaging; not an operations-chain component |
| [httpx / nuclei / naabu](https://github.com/projectdiscovery) | Pipe-first dialect: streaming JSONL, silent output, resume, sharding | Scope centred on HTTP content and port enumeration; cipher configuration delegated to pqscan |
| [Censys / Shodan](https://search.censys.io) | Large-scale PQC observation datasets | Remote datasets only; no on-demand probing of arbitrary target lists |

Port and host discovery compose with the adjacent tools. See
[Recipes](recipes.qmd). pqscan covers the cipher-configuration plane: TLS and
QUIC handshake parameters, certificates, PQC classification.

## Security

Scan only owned or authorised systems. Report findings privately. See
[Security](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/security/advisories/new) and
[`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/shsingh/pqscan/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
